svg.title: The optimal discriminator and the Jensen-Shannon identity
svg.desc: A bimodal data density against a Gaussian generator density, and the optimal discriminator they induce, which crosses one half where the densities cross.
svg.text: The discriminator reports a density ratio
V(G, D*) = -1.21808 by quadrature; 2 JSD - log 4 = -1.21808
